31-35MHz频段可用于水上移动业务，为主要业务。其中33.0MHz可用于近海: The band 31–35 MHz may be used by the maritime mobile service on a primary basis; within it, 33.0 MHz may be used for offshore safety and rescue communications, and other services shall not cause harmful interference to it. Existing fishery radio stations in the band 27.5–29.7 MHz may continue to operate until the end of their service life. Other frequencies in the band 29.7–39.5 MHz may be used by the maritime mobile service: on a primary basis in the coastal provinces, municipalities directly under the Central Government and autonomous regions, and on a secondary basis in other areas. (2010)
608-614MHz频段射电天文为主要业务，现用于北京密云区不老屯镇、新疆乌鲁木: In the band 608–614 MHz the radio astronomy service is a primary service and is currently used at Bulaotun Town, Miyun District, Beijing; the Nanshan area of Urumqi, Xinjiang; Qiannan Prefecture, Guizhou; and Taolimbaolage Gacha, Zhengxiangbai Banner, Inner Mongolia. In the band 1330–1400 MHz the radio astronomy service is a primary service and is currently used at Huairou District and Bulaotun Town, Miyun District, Beijing; Sheshan, Shanghai; Fenghuangshan, Kunming, Yunnan; the Nanshan area of Urumqi, Xinjiang; Qiannan Prefecture, Guizhou; Taolimbaolage Gacha, Zhengxiangbai Banner, Inner Mongolia; Qitai County, Xinjiang; Barkol County, Xinjiang; and Jingdong County, Pu'er, Yunnan. In the band 1718.8–1722.2 MHz the radio astronomy service is a primary service and is currently used at Huairou District and Bulaotun Town, Miyun District, Beijing; Sheshan, Shanghai; Fenghuangshan, Kunming, Yunnan; the Nanshan area of Urumqi, Xinjiang; Qiannan Prefecture, Guizhou; Taolimbaolage Gacha, Zhengxiangbai Banner, Inner Mongolia; Qitai County, Xinjiang; and Jingdong County, Pu'er, Yunnan. In the band 2655–2690 MHz the radio astronomy service is a primary service and is currently used at Huairou District, Beijing; Huaiyin, Jiangsu; Qiannan Prefecture, Guizhou; Taolimbaolage Gacha, Zhengxiangbai Banner, Inner Mongolia; Qitai County, Xinjiang; and Jingdong County, Pu'er, Yunnan. In the bands 3260–3267 MHz, 3332–3339 MHz and 3345.8–3352.5 MHz the radio astronomy service is a primary service and is currently used at Qiannan Prefecture, Guizhou; Taolimbaolage Gacha, Zhengxiangbai Banner, Inner Mongolia; Qitai County, Xinjiang; and Jingdong County, Pu'er, Yunnan. In the bands 4825–4835 MHz, 4950–4990 MHz and 4990–5000 MHz the radio astronomy service is a primary service and is currently used at the Nanshan area of Urumqi, Xinjiang; Qiannan Prefecture, Guizhou; Taolimbaolage Gacha, Zhengxiangbai Banner, Inner Mongolia; Qitai County, Xinjiang; and Jingdong County, Pu'er, Yunnan. In the band 6650–6675.2 MHz the radio astronomy service is a primary service and is currently used at Huairou District, Beijing; Zijinshan, Nanjing, Jiangsu; the Nanshan area of Urumqi, Xinjiang; Qiannan Prefecture, Guizhou; Taolimbaolage Gacha, Zhengxiangbai Banner, Inner Mongolia; Qitai County, Xinjiang; and Jingdong County, Pu'er, Yunnan. In the band 14.47–14.50 GHz the radio astronomy service is a primary service and is currently used at Bulaotun Town, Miyun District, Beijing; Taolimbaolage, Zhengxiangbai Banner, Inner Mongolia; and Qitai County, Xinjiang. In the bands 22.01–22.21 GHz, 22.81–22.86 GHz and 23.07–23.12 GHz the radio astronomy service is a primary service and is currently used at Delingha, Qinghai; Sheshan, Shanghai; the Nanshan area of Urumqi, Xinjiang; Bulaotun Town, Miyun District, Beijing; and Qitai County, Xinjiang. In the band 248–250 GHz the radio astronomy service is a primary service and is currently used at Delingha, Qinghai; Yangbajing Town, Damxung County, Lhasa, Tibet; and Qitai County, Xinjiang. Stations of other services shall not cause harmful interference to the above radio astronomy service stations. (revised 2023)
9975-10025MHz频段以次要使用条件也划分给卫星气象业务，供气象雷达使用: The band 9975–10025 MHz is also allocated to the meteorological-satellite service on a secondary basis, for use by meteorological radars.
WARC频段；不能用于通话: WARC band; not available for phone operation
下列频段：13553-13567kHz（中心频率为13560kHz），26957: The following bands: 13553–13567 kHz (centre frequency 13560 kHz), 26957–27283 kHz (centre frequency 27120 kHz), 40.66–40.70 MHz (centre frequency 40.68 MHz), 902–928 MHz in Region 2 (centre frequency 915 MHz), 2400–2500 MHz (centre frequency 2450 MHz), 5725–5875 MHz (centre frequency 5800 MHz), and 24–24.25 GHz (centre frequency 24.125 GHz), are also designated for industrial, scientific and medical (ISM) applications. Radiocommunication services operating in these bands must accept harmful interference that may be caused by these applications. ISM equipment operating in these bands is subject to the provisions of No. 15.13.
下列频段：6765-6795kHz（中心频率为6780kHz），433.05-4: The following bands: 6765–6795 kHz (centre frequency 6780 kHz), 433.05–434.79 MHz (centre frequency 433.92 MHz), 61–61.5 GHz in Region 1 except the countries listed in No. 5.280 (centre frequency 61.25 GHz), 122–123 GHz (centre frequency 122.5 GHz), and 244–246 GHz (centre frequency 245 GHz), are designated for industrial, scientific and medical (ISM) applications, subject to special authorisation by the administration concerned, after agreement with the administrations of those countries whose radiocommunication services may be affected. When invoking this provision, administrations shall have regard to the relevant latest ITU-R Recommendations.
使用135.7-137.8kHz频段内频率的业余业务台站，其最大辐射功率不得超过: Stations of the amateur service using frequencies in the band 135.7–137.8 kHz shall not exceed a maximum radiated power of 1 W (e.i.r.p.) and shall not cause harmful interference to stations of the radionavigation service operating in the countries listed in No. 5.67. (WRC-07)
使用5351.5-5366.5kHz频段的业余业务电台的最大辐射功率不得超过15: Amateur service stations using the band 5351.5–5366.5 kHz shall not exceed a maximum radiated power of 15 W (e.i.r.p.). However, in Mexico in Region 2, stations of the amateur service using the band 5351.5–5366.5 kHz shall not exceed a maximum radiated power of 20 W (e.i.r.p.). In the following Region 2 countries: Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, the Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Cuba, the Dominican Republic, Dominica, El Salvador, Ecuador, Grenada, Guatemala, Guyana, Haiti, Honduras, Jamaica, Nicaragua, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, Saint Lucia, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Suriname, Trinidad and Tobago, Uruguay, Venezuela, and the overseas special administrative regions and overseas territories of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Region 2, stations of the amateur service using the band 5351.5–5366.5 kHz shall not exceed a maximum radiated power of 25 W (e.i.r.p.). (WRC-19)
卫星地球探测业务（有源）台站不得对9200-9300MHz频段的水上无线电导航和: Stations of the Earth exploration-satellite service (active) shall not cause harmful interference to, or claim protection from, stations of the maritime radionavigation and radiolocation services in the band 9200–9300 MHz, stations of the radionavigation and radiolocation services in the band 9900–10000 MHz, and stations of the radiolocation service in the band 10.0–10.4 GHz. (WRC-15)
固定业务电台在划分给该业务的90kHz与160kHz（在1区为148.5kHz）: Stations of the fixed service in the bands allocated to that service between 90 kHz and 160 kHz (148.5 kHz in Region 1), and stations of the maritime mobile service in the bands allocated to that service between 110 kHz and 160 kHz (148.5 kHz in Region 1), may use only class A1A or F1B, A2C, A3C, F1C or F3C emissions. Stations of the maritime mobile service in the band between 110 kHz and 160 kHz (148.5 kHz in Region 1) may exceptionally also be authorised to use class J2B or J7B emissions.
在1215-1260MHz频段，卫星地球探测业务和空间研究业务中的星载有源传感器: In the band 1215–1260 MHz, spaceborne active sensors in the Earth exploration-satellite service and the space research service shall not cause harmful interference to, claim protection from, or impose constraints on the operation and development of the radiolocation service, the radionavigation-satellite service and other services allocated on a primary basis. (WRC-2000)
在1260-1300MHz频段，卫星地球探测业务和空间研究业务中的星载有源传感器: In the band 1260–1300 MHz, spaceborne active sensors in the Earth exploration-satellite service and the space research service shall not cause harmful interference to, claim protection from, or impose constraints on the operation and development of the radiolocation service and other services allocated on a primary basis in the footnote. (WRC-2000)
在3区，罗兰系统工作在1850kHz或1950kHz上，其分别占用1825-18: In Region 3 the Loran system operates on 1850 kHz or 1950 kHz, occupying the bands 1825–1875 kHz and 1925–1975 kHz respectively. Other services to which the band 1800–2000 kHz is allocated may use any frequency in that band on condition that no harmful interference is caused to the Loran system operating on 1850 kHz and 1950 kHz.
在435-438MHz，1260-1270MHz，2400-2450MHz，34: In the bands 435–438 MHz, 1260–1270 MHz, 2400–2450 MHz, 3400–3410 MHz (in Regions 2 and 3 only) and 5650–5670 MHz, the amateur-satellite service may be used on condition that no harmful interference is caused to other services operating in accordance with the table of frequency allocations (see No. 5.43). Administrations authorising such use shall ensure that any harmful interference caused by emissions from amateur-satellite service stations is eliminated immediately, in accordance with the provisions of No. 25.11. The use of the bands 1260–1270 MHz and 5650–5670 MHz by the amateur-satellite service is limited to the Earth-to-space direction.
在不干扰广播业务条件下，48.5-72.5MHz、76-84MHz可用于固定、移: On condition that no interference is caused to the broadcasting service, the bands 48.5–72.5 MHz and 76–84 MHz may be used by the fixed and mobile services. (2001)
在卫星地球探测业务和空间研究业务中，空间站雷达可按主要使用条件在78-79GHz: In the Earth exploration-satellite service and the space research service, space station radars may operate in the band 78–79 GHz on a primary basis.
在向已划分到下列频段的其它业务的电台进行指配时：13360-13410kHz，4: In making assignments to stations of other services to which the following bands are allocated: 13360–13410 kHz, 4950–4990 MHz, 102–109.5 GHz, 25550–25670 kHz, 4990–5000 MHz, 111.8–114.25 GHz, 37.5–38.25 MHz, 6650–6675.2 MHz, 128.33–128.59 GHz, 73–74.6 MHz in Regions 1 and 3, 10.6–10.68 GHz, 129.23–129.49 GHz, 150.05–153 MHz in Region 1, 14.47–14.5 GHz, 130–134 GHz, 322–328.6 MHz, 22.01–22.21 GHz, 136–148.5 GHz, 406.1–410 MHz, 22.21–22.5 GHz, 151.5–158.5 GHz, 608–614 MHz in Regions 1 and 3, 22.81–22.86 GHz, 168.59–168.93 GHz, 1330–1400 MHz, 23.07–23.12 GHz, 171.11–171.45 GHz, 1610.6–1613.8 MHz, 31.2–31.3 GHz, 172.31–172.65 GHz, 1660–1670 MHz, 31.5–31.8 GHz in Regions 1 and 3, 173.52–173.85 GHz, 1718.8–1722.2 MHz, 36.43–36.5 GHz, 195.75–196.15 GHz, 2655–2690 MHz, 42.5–43.5 GHz, 209–226 GHz, 3260–3267 MHz, 48.94–49.04 GHz, 241–250 GHz, 3332–3339 MHz, 76–86 GHz, 252–275 GHz, 3345.8–3352.5 MHz, 92–94 GHz, 4825–4835 MHz, 94.1–100 GHz, administrations are urged to take all practicable measures to protect the radio astronomy service from harmful interference. Emissions from spaceborne or airborne stations may be particularly serious sources of interference to the radio astronomy service (see Nos. 4.5 and 4.6 and Article 29). (WRC-07)
在阿尔及利亚、埃及、伊拉克、黎巴嫩、阿拉伯叙利亚共和国、苏丹、南苏丹和突尼斯，1: In Algeria, Egypt, Iraq, Lebanon, the Syrian Arab Republic, the Sudan, South Sudan and Tunisia, the use of the band 135.7–137.8 kHz is limited to the fixed and maritime mobile services. In those countries the amateur service shall not use the band 135.7–137.8 kHz, and countries authorising such use shall take this into account. (WRC-19)
现有无线电定位业务应尽早移出1535-1544MHz、1545-1645.5MH: The existing radiolocation service should be moved out of the bands 1535–1544 MHz, 1545–1645.5 MHz, 1645.5–1660 MHz, 1850–1880 MHz, 2085–2120 MHz, 3400–3800 MHz, 5925–6425 MHz, 7500–8185 MHz and 14–15.35 GHz as soon as possible; no new equipment may be brought into use from the end of 2005, although existing equipment may continue to operate until the end of its service life. (2001)
用于承担短期任务的空间操作业务（空对地）非对地静止系统使用137-148MHz频: Non-geostationary systems of the space operation service (space-to-Earth) carrying out short-duration missions shall obtain the agreement of the department concerned before using the band 137–148 MHz. (2023)
该频段可有限制地用于无线电定位业务，不得对其他业务产生有害干扰。（2001年）: This band may be used by the radiolocation service on a limited basis, on condition that no harmful interference is caused to other services. (2001)
该频段引入的有关IMT应用的国际注脚，不改变移动业务在划分表中现有业务主次地位。: The international footnote on IMT applications introduced in this band does not change the existing primary/secondary status of services in the table of frequency allocations. Studies should also be carried out as soon as possible on the application modes of the services already allocated in the band, frequency use planning, compatibility and sharing conditions between services, and coordination procedures. Until then, IMT applications shall not be put into actual deployment, except that in the band 2300–2400 MHz IMT may be used indoors. (2010)
附加划分：在亚美尼亚、阿塞拜疆、中国、科特迪瓦、俄罗斯、格鲁吉亚、伊朗、哈萨克斯: Additional allocation: in Armenia, Azerbaijan, China, Côte d'Ivoire, the Russian Federation, Georgia, Iran, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Ukraine, the band 14250–14350 kHz is also allocated to the fixed service on a primary basis. 附加划分：在阿尔及利亚、沙特阿拉伯、澳大利亚、巴林、博茨瓦纳、文莱达鲁萨兰国、中: Additional allocation: in Algeria, Saudi Arabia, Australia, Bahrain, Botswana, Brunei Darussalam, China, the Comoros, the Republic of Korea, Diego Garcia, Djibouti, Egypt, the United Arab Emirates, Eritrea, Guinea, Indonesia, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Japan, Jordan, Kuwait, Libya, Mali, Morocco, Mauritania, the Niger, New Zealand, Oman, Papua New Guinea, Qatar, the Syrian Arab Republic, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Singapore, the Sudan, South Sudan, Tunisia, Viet Nam and Yemen, the band 7100–7200 kHz is also allocated to the fixed and mobile, except aeronautical mobile (R), services on a primary basis.
